purpose: Inspect the frozen champion's individual causal daily candlestick paths, compress recurring entry/exit observations into a few rules, and test those rules through a strictly chronological three-stage development protocol.

chart_contract.window: 40 completed stock sessions before the signal date through 25 sessions after entry, where available
chart_contract.price_coordinate: corporate-action-consistent cumulative log-return coordinate; intraday OHLC scaled by raw OHLC/close
panels: turnover/amount activity relative to trailing 20-session median
chart_contract.outcome_labels: allowed only for the currently opened development stage

round_1_visual_discovery.scope: review every individual trade chart; compare winners, ordinary trades, and severe losers

round_2_pruning.rule_freeze: all Round-1 definitions and thresholds frozen before 2020 outcomes are aggregated
keep_all_required: at least +0.50 percentage point mean net-payoff improvement or at least 2 percentage point severe-loss improvement
simple causal action at next legal open

round_3_internal_validation.status: unopened until surviving rules and at most one simple combination are frozen

allowed_entry_roles: one-session delay only if signal remains valid and fill contract is causal
allowed_exit_roles: one deterministic d3 or d5 next-open exit trigger

portfolio_gate.baseline: exact frozen Industry Diffusion plus Weekly Low-MAX, equal-weight weekly cohorts, 20-session lifecycle, 20 bps per side
portfolio_gate.failure_action: retain the frozen champion unchanged; no rescue rule

prohibited: changing Industry Diffusion, Weekly Low-MAX, Top-10, weekly schedule, cohort weights, or baseline cost
trying multiple entry, exit, sizing, and habitat roles for the same observation
using future extrema to define an entry predictor
relabeling internal chronological validation as OOS or confirmation
rescuing a failed rule after Round 3 is opened
